test_sparse_multihead_attention: test the SparseMultiheadAttention module to verify sparse mask generation for bidirectional and unidirectional attention
run_buffered_sparse_mask_bidirectional: run the buffered_sparse_mask method on a bidirectional SparseMultiheadAttention instance with stride 4 and expressivity 1
